explanation: This is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at every D2 except one: the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition. It then reaches 8-10 when that a2 choice is a fresh switch or alternation away from recent a1 choices, usually after an unrewarded trial, and it stays 0 (or at most 2-5) when a2 has already been chosen for several trials in a row, after a rare transition, or after any a1 choice.
